historical_replay.observed: The 2026-10-03 DBA article was generated and approved but remained GENERATED until protected GitHub delivery completed.
historical_replay.prevention_verified: The exact approved slug is delivered through one candidate PR with required checks, production deployment and public readback; duplicate/stale candidates are closed rather than merged.

learning: A generated blog artifact is not terminal until protected merge, Netlify production identity and public readback exist.
Bot-created publication PRs must include complete machine-readable delivery metadata and material writeback closure in the initial candidate.
Stale conflicting candidates must be replaced by one current-main successor; never resolve by parallel publication.
